chips.name: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395
chips.npuNote: XDNA 2 NPU: 50 TOPS. AMD also quotes 126 platform TOPS (CPU+GPU+NPU combined).
chips.memBwNote: Derived: 256-bit LPDDR5X-8000 (vendor spec) = 8000 MT/s x 32 B = 256 GB/s. AMD publishes the memory spec, not the GB/s figure.

chips.name: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D
chips.clockNote: Up to 5.7 GHz max boost; 128 MB L3 (3D V-Cache).
chips.memBwNote: Derived: dual-channel DDR5-5600 (vendor max spec) = 5600 MT/s x 16 B = 89.6 GB/s. AMD publishes the memory spec, not the GB/s figure.
chips.sourceNote: AMD product spec page (launch date 03/12/2025 on page).
